# pocketid_apis (Data Source)

Lists every Pocket ID API (protected resource) with its permissions, in creation order. Requires Pocket ID 2.14.0 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every API, oldest first.
data "pocketid_apis" "all" {}

output "api_resources" {
  value = [for api in data.pocketid_apis.all.apis : api.resource]
}

# APIs open to clients registered through a Client ID Metadata Document.
output "cimd_apis" {
  value = [for api in data.pocketid_apis.all.apis : api.name if api.allow_cimd_clients]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `apis` (Attributes List) Every API, oldest first. The list is complete: every page is read, and a list that changes while it is read is an error. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apis))

<a id="nestedatt--apis"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apis`

Read-Only:

- `allow_cimd_clients` (Boolean) Whether clients registered through a Client ID Metadata Document may request user-delegated tokens for the API, with the permissions that have `allowed_for_cimd_clients` set.
- `created_at` (String) When the API was created, as reported by Pocket ID.
- `id` (String) The ID of the API.
- `name` (String) The display name of the API.
- `permissions` (Attributes Map) The API's permissions, keyed by permission key (the scope a client requests). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apis--permissions))
- `resource` (String) The resource identifier clients send to request tokens for the API.

<a id="nestedatt--apis--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apis.permissions`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_for_cimd_clients` (Boolean) Whether clients registered through a Client ID Metadata Document may request this permission.
- `description` (String) The permission's description; null when it has none.
- `id` (String) The permission's ID.
- `name` (String) The permission's display name.
